turns.assessment: The simultaneous failure of about 130 services, all whose working paths traverse S08, localizes the event to the shared S08 infrastructure. The broad impact across many ingress/egress degrees, together with unchanged optical power, OSNR, BER, and amplifier telemetry, rules strongly against fibre, amplifier, line-interface, and single WSS-port faults. An OTN switch-fabric failure at S08 directly explains interruption of every ODU cross-connected through it while leaving the optical layer unchanged.

proposals.rationale: E1 (otn.S08) is common to every affected working path. A switch-fabric failure produces the observed simultaneous, service-wide ODU interruption without optical-layer changes; unaffected services not transiting the S08 switch and SNCP services that successfully switched are consistent with this.
